tools.name: query_claims
tools.description:
Search claim statements and excerpts.

    A domain keeps claims whose primary domain is that value or one of its
    aliases, such as cs.LG for ai-ml. An exact multi-token phrase matches whole
    tokens. A single ordinary token also matches its singular or plural.
    When no stored claim holds ev

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description:
Provenance for one claim. Excerpts are short unless full_text is true.

    unpublished is true for a private unpublished paper. The stored excerpt, page, and section stay on provenance. An empty provenance doi is filled from a DOI already stored on that row, including the DataCite DOI of an arXiv i

tools.name: get_contradictions
tools.description:
List claims stored as contradicting one claim.

    Returns each opposing claim id, status, evidence strength, and opposition strength.
    Example: get_contradictions(claim_id="<id from query_claims>").

tools.name: get_updates
tools.description:
List claims whose last_updated is at or after a timestamp.

    Use this to read claims that changed after a time you already checked.
    Returns claim id, status, evidence strength, a shortened excerpt, and source_url, doi, and paper_id when those are known.
    Example: get_updates(since="2026-01

tools.name: get_innovation_flags
tools.description:
List innovation flags. The default sort is discovery.

    Use this when you want links between claims rather than the claims themselves.
    Pass claim_id to navigate from one claim to the flags that contain it. Each hit includes flag_type, strength, summary, the other claim ids, and those claims'

tools.name: search_smart
tools.description:
Find claims from a natural-language question.

    The central research concept and its scientific synonyms outrank incidental context words. Generic overlap that does not address the question is penalized. A keyword with no function word stays on the lexical match.
    A question tries its content

tools.name: get_authors
tools.description:
List authors linked to one claim.

    Use this when you have a claim id and need the people linked to it.
    Returns author id, name, and orcid. The list is empty when none are linked.
    Example: get_authors(claim_id="claim-attention").
    Example: get_authors(claim_id="<id from query_claims>")
